name: Humanitributary
description: The data platform behind an interactive, cited timeline of all history: the admin, the agent API and the scheduled jobs (docs/adr/0020-heroku-hosting.md).

ENVIRONMENT.description: Anything but dev turns on production safety (staging, prod).

ALLOWED_HOSTS.description: Comma-separated host names: the app's herokuapp.com domain, later the custom domain.

INGEST_CONTACT.description: The contact in the bot's User-Agent: a project URL, never a person.

STORAGE_BACKEND.description: local accepts a dyno's throwaway disk until the S3_* variables are set (ADR 0016); remove it then.
